Evergreen Exterior Services

Bringing living wall innovation to the landscaping industry.

Life on Walls is pleased to partner with Evergreen Exterior Services, an established wholesale plant nursery based in Banstead, Surrey, with a strong reputation for horticultural expertise, plant sourcing and trade supply.

Visit Evergreen’s websiteFind the nursery

01 — Overview

Innovative living wall systems for trade customers.

With a strong reputation for horticultural expertise, plant sourcing and trade supply, Evergreen supports landscape professionals, garden designers, contractors and garden centres across the UK.

Through our partnership, Evergreen is introducing selected Life on Walls products to its offering, giving trade customers more opportunities to incorporate innovative, modular living wall systems into their projects.

02 — About Evergreen

A broad plant range, delivered nationwide.

Established in 1986, Evergreen Exterior Services supplies an extensive selection of plants, including trees, shrubs, climbers, grasses, perennials and specimen plants.

Operating from its main nursery in Banstead, Evergreen combines a broad plant range with a dedicated delivery network serving trade customers nationwide.

03 — Our partnership

Horticultural knowledge meets living wall technology.

By combining Evergreen’s horticultural knowledge and established trade network with Life on Walls’ innovative living wall technology, we aim to make vertical greening more accessible to landscape professionals.

The partnership will showcase selected Living Louvres products, helping customers explore practical solutions for incorporating greenery into gardens, terraces, commercial spaces and other projects.

05 — Questions

Frequently asked questions

Who is Evergreen Exterior Services?

Evergreen Exterior Services is a wholesale plant nursery based at 21 Croydon Lane, Banstead, Surrey. Established in 1986, it supplies trees, shrubs, climbers, grasses, perennials and specimen plants to landscape professionals, garden designers, contractors and garden centres across the UK.

What is the partnership between Life on Walls and Evergreen?

Through the partnership, Evergreen is introducing selected Life on Walls products to its offering. It brings together Evergreen’s horticultural knowledge and trade network with Life on Walls’ living wall technology, to make vertical greening more accessible to landscape professionals.

Which Life on Walls products are available through Evergreen?

The partnership showcases selected Living Louvres products, a modular planted louvre system for adding greenery to gardens, terraces, commercial spaces and other projects. Contact Evergreen or Life on Walls for current availability.

Where is Evergreen Exterior Services located?

Evergreen’s main nursery is at 21 Croydon Lane, Banstead, Surrey SM7 3BW. It also runs a delivery network serving trade customers nationwide.
